inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero filer: no share-based payment expense in the FY2025 cash-flow reconciliation (AR FY2025 lines 5545-5572) or notes; the 2009 Incentive Award Scheme is funded by trustee-held shares bought in 2009 and is being wound down (HK$669m of award shares SOLD in FY2025). Treated as genuinely zero, not missing.
inputs.buyback_note: H1 FY2026 repurchased 37,853,700 shares for HK$698.2m (Apr-Jun 2026, avg ~HK$18.4; interim report p.1246-1253), not yet cancelled at the report date; FY2025 repurchases HK$43.2m. Count is held flat regardless (SBC is zero, so there is nothing to offset); buybacks at prices below IV are modestly accretive and not credited.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and quote both HKD; no conversion. Economic exposure is RMB (99.1% of borrowings and most assets/flows are RMB; HKD is the presentation currency).
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,314,012,871 shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (interim report line 3470) less 37,853,700 repurchased and held pending cancellation = 2,276.16m. No potential ordinary shares exist (no diluted EPS presented, interim note line 3033), so basic = fully diluted. Trustee-held award-scheme shares are a residual (273,100 at Jun-2025) and are left in the count. Held FLAT: SBC is zero so there is no dilution to charge.
inputs.net_debt_basis: Total borrowings HK$27,375.8m at 30 June 2026 = bank and other borrowings 16,847.0 current + 6,499.1 non-current + medium-term notes 4,029.7 (interim BS lines 1949/1992/1994; ties to the 'Total borrowings' highlight line 1584). MD&A's 'HK$23.35bn' excludes the MTN. Cash = bank balances and cash HK$8,901.6m (line 1919). Lease liabilities (HK$626.5m) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Structured deposits HK$4,323.3m (FVTPL, interim note line 3199) are carried in the equity bridge, not in cash. A further RMB2.5bn MTN issued Aug-2026 refinances bank loans and is debt-neutral.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in HKD (pegged to USD; RMB economics). Rf 3.8% (10y HK government / USD-peg proxy), ERP 6.0%, beta 0.70 for a regulated gas distributor, +1.0pp China regulatory/SOE-governance premium -> cost of equity ~9.0%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~2.5% (Aug-2026 MTN coupons 1.57-1.70% RMB; bank loans 1.85-4.50%), after-tax ~1.9%. Weights at market: equity (incl. NCI) ~78% / net debt ~22% of EV -> WACC 7.4%, rounded to 7.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: risk is carried in the driver paths and the probability weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Full lease cash cost (principal HK$175.9m + interest ~HK$14m in FY2025, cash-flow statement line 5678/5696 and segment note 'finance costs other than interest on lease liabilities') = 0.19% of revenue, charged as lease_cost_pct_path 0.2%. Lease liabilities excluded from net debt. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A 4,044.6 less ROU depreciation 325.8 = 3,718.9 = 3.8% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows made ATTRIBUTABLE-ONLY via the combined tax+leakage driver (cash_tax_rate_path 50%): PRC EIT ~28% of EBIT (FY2025 income tax 1,793.8 on PBT ex JV/associate results of 6,339.8 = 28.3%; cash tax paid 2,019.1) compounded with the NCI share of after-tax profit of 30.4% (FY2025 NCI 1,550.8 of 5,097.6; H1 FY2026 28.5%) -> 1-(0.72 x 0.696) = 49.9%. NCI equity (HK$25,701.9m at 30 June 2026) is NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY0 unlevered NOPAT at 50% on modelled EBIT of ~6,890 = ~3,445 vs reported attributable profit 3,546.8, which includes +551.6 JV/associate results and +186.9 interest income (both excluded from the flows and matched by bridge assets) and -638.7 finance costs (in the WACC): ties within non-operating noise. Conservative element: 100% of group net debt (HK$18.5bn) is deducted against attributable-only flows even though NCI co-owns some project-level borrowings; the over-deduction is at most ~HK$2.4/share. Cross-check at 100% flows / 28% tax / NCI deducted at book gives a base value within ~HK$1/share of the house figure.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, with the non-US adaptations (NCI leakage, lease treatment B, matching-asset bridge, SBC-zero). Why: CR Gas is an operating utility whose value is a stream of regulated dollar-margin cash flow; it is not a bank, REIT or holdco, and the SOE-backed concession portfolio is a single consolidated business. Why not a simple single-entity owner-FCF model: 30% of after-tax profit leaks to minorities and HK$23.6bn of book sits in JVs/associates whose income is outside EBITDA, so NCI is charged through the leakage driver and JV/associate/structured-deposit assets are added in the bridge (matching-asset rule). EBITDA basis: IFRS-16, pre-lease, excluding interest income, dividend income and JV/associate results = operating cash flows before working-capital movements (FY2025 10,802.7 = 11.05% of revenue; FY2024 10.74%). Working capital capture 0% in all scenarios: the group is net-payable-funded (payables 31.5bn vs receivables + inventory + contract assets 20.8bn) so growth releases cash, but connection-fee contract liabilities (7.0bn, down from 15.2bn in FY2021) are running off as new connections fall; the two roughly offset and neither scales with revenue growth. Capex on the cash basis (3.3% FY2025, 4.1% FY2024, 5.1% FY2023; H1 FY2026 pipeline capex HK$2.19bn) set to 3.6% rising to 3.8% = D&A at maturity for a built-out network; 'additions to non-current assets' of 5.9bn in FY2025 includes customer-funded contract works and ROU assets and is not the cash figure. Terminal cap 15x owner FCF (12x bear) for a mature utility with flat national gas demand; Gordon at 7.5%/2% would be 18.5x, so the cap binds in base. House and street bases coincide (SBC zero): band_position is null by construction. Price is an intraday HKEX print and should be refreshed at the next regular close.

equity_bridge.item: Interests in joint ventures and associates at 12x normalised share of results
equity_bridge.note: Book HK$23,559.5m (JV 18,279.5 + associates 5,280.0, interim BS lines 1897-1898) earns only HK$551.6m (FY2025) / 748.3m (FY2024) / 332.7m (H1 FY2026, 665 annualised) of share of results and paid 221.8m of dividends in FY2025 - a 2.3% return on book. Book is not fair value for a stream the owner cannot direct; capitalised instead at 12x a normalised HK$650m = HK$7.8bn (0.33x book). Income is excluded from EBITDA, so this is the matching asset. A reader who takes book value adds ~HK$6.9/share.

equity_bridge.item: Loans to a joint venture at book
equity_bridge.note: Interest-bearing unsecured loan, interim note 11 (line 1912); its interest income is excluded from the flows.

Short-dated bank wealth-management deposits actively rolled (FY2025: HK$18.7bn purchased, 17.7bn redeemed); cash-like but outside 'bank balances and cash'. Interim note line 3199. Their return is excluded from the flows.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: attributable-equity CAGR ~4% (FY2020-25) haircut for the structural decline in connection fees and flat national gas demand; brackets the FY2022-25 revenue CAGR of 1.2% and the FY2026 base-year growth of 3.5%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+4.0%) diverges >30% from both revenue (+11.8% 5yr, inflated by FY2021-22 gas-price pass-through and the Chongqing/Tianjin consolidations) and EPS (-7.7% 5yr: connection-fee profit fell from HK$5.1bn FY2021 to 1.9bn FY2025). Earnings momentum is negative while book compounds through retained earnings at a falling ROE (8.0% FY2025 vs 9.9% FY2024).
historical_growth.notes: FCF series is group reported FCF (OCF - PP&E payments); SBC is zero and interest income is already outside OCF (interest received sits in investing), so the owner-FCF adjustments are nil and the CAGRs are unaffected. FY2022 FCF was negative (-1,887) so the 3yr FCF CAGR is undefined; FY2023-25 went 5,008 -> 2,804 -> 3,364. Attributable owner FCF (group FCF less lease cash and NCI dividends) was HK$1.7bn in FY2025 after a HK$2.2bn working-capital outflow (contract-liability run-off and payables), ~HK$3.3bn before it. Base CAGRs: revenue FY2020 55,864 -> FY2025 97,733; FY2022 94,338 -> FY2025 97,733. EPS 2.31 -> 1.55; 2.09 -> 1.55. Attributable equity 36,274 -> 44,176; 39,308 -> 44,176.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue +3.5% (H1 already +5.2%; H2 FY2025 base was weak), then 2-2.5% nominal as gas volume grows ~1% and pass-through lifts tariffs. EBITDA margin eases from 11.05% to 10.6% over three years as connection-fee profit (HK$1.9bn FY2025, falling ~30%/yr) keeps shrinking faster than comprehensive-services and integrated-energy profit (+13-18%/yr on a HK$1.6bn base) grows, then recovers to 10.8% as the mix stabilises and dollar-margin pass-through normalises. Capex converges to D&A. Cash tax + NCI leakage 50% throughout.

bull.narrative: Dollar-margin recovery: provincial pass-through catches up with procurement costs (as the 2026 Shanghai oil-linked pilot spreads), industrial/commercial volume grows 3-4% under dual-carbon coal-to-gas policy, gasification rate climbs from 62.8% toward 70%, and the 15th Five-Year Plan pipeline-renewal programme is funded by tariffs. Comprehensive services and integrated energy compound at double digits and lift group EBITDA margin to 11.8%. Bolt-on 'One City, One Network' deals add volume at low multiples. Capex runs above D&A to fund the growth.

bear.narrative: National gas consumption keeps falling (H1 FY2026 -2.4%) as electrification and weak manufacturing bite; connection fees collapse to a maintenance trickle by FY2028 with no property recovery; local governments delay pass-through through another LNG shock so the gas-sales dollar margin compresses; revenue stalls and EBITDA margin settles at 9.6%. Mandated safety renovation of ageing pipelines (HK$1.4bn in FY2025) pushes capex above D&A with no tariff recovery. Terminal growth 1% and a 12x cap for an ex-growth regulated asset.

scenario_narratives.base: A mature regulated distributor: volume growth ~1%, tariff pass-through roughly keeps pace with procurement cost, connection-fee profit continues to erode but is progressively replaced by services/integrated-energy profit, margin dips then stabilises, capex converges to D&A, and 30% of every dollar leaks to project-level minorities. Value is essentially a 15x multiple on ~HK$4bn of attributable owner FCF less HK$18.5bn of net debt plus HK$14bn of JV, loan and deposit assets.
scenario_narratives.bull: Pricing reform and policy support restore the dollar margin, industrial volume growth resumes and the 'two new engines' scale, taking EBITDA margin to 11.8% on 3-5% revenue growth. The bull case needs three independent things (pass-through, volume, services margin) to go right.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural demand decline plus regulatory lag: flat revenue, 9.6% EBITDA margin, capex above D&A for mandated safety work, 12x exit. No solvency question (A2/A-, HK$85bn of facilities), so the floor is a low-return regulated asset rather than distress.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the connection-fee decline (-20% new paid connections FY2025, segment profit -35%/yr) has no visible bottom, national gas consumption turned negative in H1 FY2026, and the core dollar margin depends on local-government pass-through the company does not control - a single-regulator dependency in each province. Bull cut to 20% because it requires pass-through reform, an industrial-volume recovery and services margin expansion to coincide. Base 50%: H1 FY2026 (+5% revenue, +1% attributable profit, margin held at 17.1% gross) is consistent with the base path, not the bear.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value CR Gas as the owner of ~70% of a regulated, slow-growth cash stream: attributable owner FCF built from a pre-lease IFRS-16 EBITDA margin, with cash tax and the 30% minority share charged together, net debt deducted in full, and the HK$23.6bn of JV/associate book carried at an earnings-based HK$7.8bn rather than at book. The terminal multiple is capped at 15x FCF (12x bear) because the Gordon value at 7.5%/2% implies a multiple a buyer of an ex-growth Chinese utility is unlikely to pay. The resulting base case sits near the top of the sell-side HK$20-23 target range; the probability weighting (30% bear) is what brings the weighted value down toward the current price.
key_risks_to_valuation: Tariff pass-through lag: a 0.5pp EBITDA-margin miss on HK$100bn of revenue is HK$500m of EBITDA and ~HK$250m of attributable FCF (~HK$1.6/share at 15x)
Connection-fee run-off faster than services growth: each HK$500m of lost connection profit not replaced is ~HK$1.6/share
NCI leakage rising above 30% if the fully-owned parent-level profit (connection, trading) shrinks while project-level JV profit holds
JV/associate value: carried at 0.33x book; the gap to book is HK$6.9/share either way
100% of net debt deducted against 70% of flows: conservative by up to HK$2.4/share
Capex: if accrual additions (HK$5.9bn FY2025) rather than cash capex (HK$3.2bn) are the true maintenance level, FCF is ~HK$1.5bn/yr lower and the base value falls by roughly a third
Terminal cap: at the uncapped Gordon value the base case is ~HK$3-4/share higher; at a 12x cap it is ~HK$3/share lower
